schema.title: Response List Rules Api V1 Me Rules Get

get.description:
Every rule of yours with its responses, no ids: `{version: 1, rules: [...]}`.

Services are named (`serviceName`), not identified. Headers and bodies are exported as stored:
**they may contain secrets you put there**, so look before you share the file.

post.description:
All or nothing. Everything is validated first; every problem is reported at once as
`rules.<index>.<field>`. `merge` (default) adds the rules to yours (importing a file twice
duplicates them); `replace` deletes your current rules first.

parameters.description: Add to, or replace, your rules.
parameters.name: mode

schema.description: Add to, or replace, your rules.
schema.title: Mode

post.description: Turn every rule on or off at once (FR-11). `updated` counts the rules that changed.

put.description: Replaces the rule's own fields; its responses are untouched.

post.description: The first response of a rule becomes its active one; later ones wait to be activated.

delete.description: The last response of a rule can't be deleted (`409 last_response`, G-3).

post.description: Makes this response the one the Gateway serves; returns the rule.

Nothing is sent: it runs the Gateway's matching and Service resolution on your rules.

Always `200`; `outcome` is `mock`, `proxy` or `error` (with the Gateway's `errorCode`).
